summary.allegation: The issuer says the cardholder paid GBP 412.75 for a freight collection and delivery that never happened, so no service was received.
summary.to_defend: The merchant must show proof of delivery or service rendered for this transaction, dated before the chargeback, to an address matching the cardholder's records.

requirements.title: Proof of delivery or service
requirements.text: Proof of delivery (tracking + carrier confirmation) or proof of service rendered (access logs, attendance, completed booking).
requirements.finding: The merchant is the carrier (MCC 4214) and its manifest records consignment TF-9051 expressly referenced to txn_7745MN as collected at 11:30 and delivered at 17:14 on 22 April 2025, signed for at destination. The record is the merchant's own operational manifest and the POD image itself (POD-9051-img) is referenced but not attached, so the proof is thin, though it does identify this transaction with collection and delivery timestamps.

requirements.title: Before chargeback date
requirements.text: Date of delivery / service is before the chargeback date.
requirements.finding: The service was performed on 22 April 2025, the same day as the 22 April 2025 authorisation, and well before the 14 May 2025 chargeback date.

requirements.finding: The manifest shows pickup at LS1 4DT and delivery at LS9 8AA, which match the billing and shipping postcodes held for this transaction, and AVS returned a full match (Y) with CVV M and 3DS authenticated.

justification: Represent: R1 is met by the carrier's own manifest line tying consignment TF-9051 to txn_7745MN with collection and delivery times, and R2 and R3 follow from the same record.
rationale:
The issuer alleges the freight was never collected and no service was provided for the GBP 412.75 charge of 22 April 2025.
The merchant's manifest records consignment TF-9051, expressly referenced to transaction txn_7745MN, collected from LS1 4DT at 11:30 and delivered to LS9 8AA at 17:14 on 22 April 2025, signed for at destination.
The service date of 22 April 2025 precedes the 14 May 2025 chargeback by three weeks.
Pickup and delivery postcodes match the billing (LS1 4DT) and shipping (LS9 8AA) addresses on file, with AVS Y, CVV M and a 3DS authenticated transaction.
Attach the POD image POD-9051-img with the representment to close the only soft point in the file.
